public_rationale: The reported cash balance alone cannot establish inability to pay Oracle. The new compute purchases reportedly begin in 2027, while the required deposits, existing bills, and available financing are undisclosed. Comparing current cash with the entire multiyear contract would test a different proposition. The available records do not establish a matched liquidity shortfall or surplus.
limitations: Historical cash figures are press reports, not directly available financial statements.
The latest completed quarter-end is an imperfect proxy for the publication-date state.
The Reuters syndication has September 29/30 dating differences; September 30 is used conservatively.
The observation concerns a past state, but its truth was not established publicly by the evaluation date.
